coverage.note: only quote posts by accounts that are themselves in the corpus are visible; a launch with no visible quote may still have been quoted

_meta.corpus: launch-type posts (launch, open-source release) in the Community Archive part of the 4.48M-post corpus; main set 1,980 posts of 530 company and founder accounts; pooled set 3,654 posts of 1,657 accounts
_meta.rule: identical to the launch track (scripts/launch/build_launch_evidence.py); when the main set has under 200 pairs or 25 accounts the rule is applied to every account pooled and the result is at most grade C
_meta.baseline: median likes of the account's previous 30 posts (at least 8)
_meta.multiple_testing: about 45 new comparisons on top of the launch track's 30; one or two passing by chance would not be surprising
_meta.trait_precision_read_by_hand: 7 samples per text trait read once: clean for cta_try, offer_free, offer_open_source, benchmark_claim, compares_named, superlative_first, availability_now, cta_waitlist (research previews count); noisy (about half correct) for offer_credits_discount, names_customer, backstory, coming_soon, backed_by; teaser posts about half are teasers of the launch that followed
not_observable: video length (duration_ms is empty for all 852 video launch posts)
replies (link in reply, thread body, replies from well-known accounts, replying to commenters)
what an image shows (chart, face, screenshot) - see the media track
